newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Yaohan Int'l, Caterers suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Yaohan Int'l, Caterers suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Yaohan International Holdings Ltd and Yaohan International Caterers Ltd was suspended at the companies' request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Tuesday.
Shares of Yaohan International ended one cent down at HK$0.68 per share on Monday while Yaohan Caterers was unchanged at HK$2.025.
Yaohan Caterers, an operator of restaurants and bakeries, has reported a 17 percent rise in interim profit to HK$47.76 million for the six months to September 30.
Department stores operator Yaohan International has posted an interim loss of HK$91.93 million for the six months to September 30, from HK$33.75 million profit a year earlier.
